requirement: Clean miss and clean hit ProbeAck permissions and metadata update
test_behavior: For an absent line the test checks NtoN on both ProbeAck outputs and accepts at most one metadata write that selects no way; for a Branch hit it checks BtoN and a metadata write changing the matched way to Nothing.

requirement: Registered metadata response, conflicting set retry and dirty delegation
test_behavior: The test drives a two-cycle metadata response, independently stalls wb_rdy and mshr_rdy, and waits for dirty writeback completion. It checks distinct nonzero cache-set indices.

requirement: Backpressured metadata, LSU and TileLink transfers
